The game is remembered on the C64 for its fast-paced action and faithful conversion of the arcade experience.

video:video.video:title: 20 Tons – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer

It is a classic example of the thoughtful, single-screen puzzle design popular on budget C64 releases

video:video.video:title: 720 Degrees – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch 720 Degrees on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. 720 Degrees is a skateboarding sports game released on the Commodore 64 in 1987, based on Atari's arcade title. Set in the sprawling Skate City, you perform tricks, collect points, and avoid obstacles while racing against the clock. The C64 version is noted for capturing the arcade's free-roaming structure and energetic skating atmosphere.

video:video.video:title: A Nightmare On Elm Street – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch A Nightmare On Elm Street on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. A Nightmare on Elm Street is a Commodore 64 action game based on the popular horror film series. you must rescue their friends from the dream world while avoiding the deadly Freddy Krueger, balancing arcade-style gameplay with light puzzle elements. The game stands out as one of the more atmospheric licensed horror titles on the C64.

video:video.video:title: A Question Of Sport – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch A Question Of Sport on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Based on the long-running BBC television quiz show, A Question of Sport brings competitive sports trivia to the Commodore 64. Two teams compete by answering questions drawn from a wide range of sporting topics, closely mirroring the format of the TV programme. It remains a popular quiz title among fans of British television adaptations.

video:video.video:title: Accolade's Comics – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Accolade's Comics on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Accolade's Comics is a narrative-driven adventure game for the Commodore 64 released in 1987. you guide a young boy who becomes immersed in a comic-book story starring secret agent Steve Keene. The game blends interactive storytelling with puzzle-solving and is remembered for its comic-style presentation.

video:video.video:title: Ace Of Aces – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Ace Of Aces on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Ace of Aces is a 1986 Commodore 64 World War II flight combat game published by Accolade. Played from a first-person cockpit view, it places the player in control of a British RAF Mosquito fighter-bomber on a series of combat missions. Objectives include intercepting V-1 flying bombs, attacking trains and U-boats, and engaging enemy aircraft, combining arcade action with light simulation elements. The game is widely remembered for its cinematic presentation and immersive atmosphere on the C64.

video:video.video:title: Action Biker – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Action Biker on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Action Biker is a Commodore 64 arcade racing game featuring Clumsy Colin, a character from the British comic Buster and later used as the mascot for KP Skips. you race against the clock across obstacle-filled courses, performing jumps and stunts to score points. The game is fondly remembered for its fast-paced gameplay and distinctive licensed character.

video:video.video:title: Action Service – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Action Service on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Action Service is a Commodore 64 military-themed arcade strategy game released in 1989. you undergo training across a series of boot camp-style challenges that test reflexes and timing. The game blends action sequences with mission-based progression, reflecting Infogrames' experimental approach to arcade design.

video:video.video:title: After Burner – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch After Burner on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. After Burner is a fast-paced Commodore 64 arcade shooter based on Sega's hugely popular coin-op. you pilot an F-14 Tomcat through high-speed aerial combat, blasting enemy aircraft and ground targets across a series of scrolling battle zones. The C64 version is remembered for its ambitious attempt to recreate the scale, speed, and spectacle of the arcade original on home hardware..

video:video.video:title: Agony – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Agony on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Agony is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up released for the Amiga in 1992 by Psygnosis. Featuring six lengthy levels, the game focuses on precision shooting and enemy patterns rather than overwhelming speed. Its dark fantasy setting, detailed artwork, and atmospheric presentation give it a more measured feel compared to faster, more frantic shooters of the era..

video:video.video:title: Airborne Ranger – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Airborne Ranger on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Airborne Ranger is a Commodore 64 action-simulation game developed by MicroProse in 1987. you take on the role of a U.S. Army airborne ranger, planning and executing covert military missions behind enemy lines. Combining strategic planning with real-time action, the game stood out on the C64 for its tactical depth and realistic military theme.

video:video.video:title: Airwolf – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Airwolf on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Airwolf is a Commodore 64 action game based on the popular television series of the same name. you pilot a high-tech attack helicopter through maze-like environments, avoiding obstacles while destroying enemy targets. The game is known for its emphasis on precise control and timing rather than straightforward shooting.

video:video.video:title: Aladdin – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Aladdin on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Disney’s Aladdin (1994) on the Commodore Amiga is a colourful side-scrolling platformer by Virgin Interactive. Guide Aladdin through Agrabah and the Cave of Wonders, fighting guards with a scimitar and throwing apples while collecting gems and bonus tokens. Known for its fluid animation and film-inspired levels.

video:video.video:title: Alcatraz – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Alcatraz on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Alcatraz is an Amiga action-adventure game released in 1992. The story centres on a drug baron who has seized control of Alcatraz prison, with the player cast as a U.S. Navy SEAL sent in to stop him. The game blends arcade combat with exploration elements and is remembered for its gritty premise and varied mission structure.

video:video.video:title: Alcazar: The Forgotten Fortress – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Alcazar: The Forgotten Fortress on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Alcazar: The Forgotten Fortress is a Commodore 64 action-adventure game released by Activision in 1985. you guide an explorer on a dangerous journey through the ancient fortress of Alcazar, solving puzzles and avoiding traps along the way. The game is noted for its tense atmosphere and methodical, exploration-focused gameplay.

video:video.video:title: Alien – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Alien on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Alien is a Commodore 64 strategy game inspired by the 1979 science-fiction horror film. Following the events of the movie, you must manage resources, protect crew members, and survive the deadly alien threat aboard the spaceship. The game emphasises tension and planning, making it one of the more distinctive licensed horror titles on the C64.

video:video.video:title: Alien Breed – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Alien Breed on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Alien Breed is a top-down science-fiction shooter released for the Amiga in 1991 by Team17. Strongly inspired by the atmosphere of the Aliens films, the game combines intense action with exploration and light puzzle-solving. It became one of the Amiga's most recognisable shooters, praised for its graphics, sound, and moody presentation.

video:video.video:title: Aliens: The Computer Game – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Aliens: The Computer Game on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Aliens: The Computer Game is a Commodore 64 adaptation of the science-fiction film Aliens. The Electric Dreams version focuses on straightforward action gameplay, while the US release features a series of mini-games representing different scenes from the movie. Together, they offer a varied and ambitious licensed experience on the C64.

video:video.video:title: Alleykat – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Alleykat on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Alleykat is a Commodore 64 arcade game released in 1986 that blends elements of racing and shoot 'em up gameplay. you guide a mischievous cat through a variety of fast-paced challenges, dodging hazards and completing objectives across multiple screens. The game is remembered for its humour, variety, and colourful presentation.

video:video.video:title: Alter Ego – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Alter Ego on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Alter Ego is a unique Commodore 64 life-simulation game released by Activision in 1986. you guide a character from childhood through adulthood, making decisions that shape their personality, career, and relationships. Unusual for its time, the game focuses on choice and consequence rather than traditional action, earning it a lasting reputation as an experimental classic.

video:video.video:title: American 3D Pool – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch American 3D Pool on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. American 3D Pool is a Commodore 64 sports game released in 1991 by Zeppelin Games. Offering both pool and billiards, the game uses a distinctive pseudo-3D viewpoint to simulate realistic table play. It is widely regarded as one of the most accomplished cue sports games available on the C64.

video:video.video:title: Android 2 – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Android 2 on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Android 2 is an arcade-style Commodore 64 game released by Ocean in 1983. you navigate hazardous environments while avoiding enemies and traps, relying on quick reflexes and careful movement. As an early C64 release, it reflects the straightforward yet challenging design common to the platform's formative years.

video:video.video:title: Android Nim – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Android Nim on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Android Nim is a Commodore 64 puzzle and strategy game released in 1985 by 64 Tape Computing. Based on the classic mathematical game of Nim, you must outthink their opponent by removing objects according to strict rules. The game offers a cerebral alternative to arcade action, focusing on logic and planning.

video:video.video:title: Andy Capp – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Andy Capp on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Andy Capp is a Commodore 64 adventure game released in 1987 by Mirrorsoft, based on the long-running British comic strip. you take control of the famously lazy and mischievous character, navigating everyday situations through exploration and problem-solving. The game is remembered for its humour and strong British cultural identity.

video:video.video:title: Another World – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Another World on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Another World is a cinematic action-adventure game released on the Amiga in 1991. you follow scientist Lester Knight Chaykin as he is transported to a mysterious alien world filled with danger and intrigue. Renowned for its storytelling, animation, and atmosphere, the game is widely regarded as one of the Amiga's defining titles.

video:video.video:title: Ant Attack – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Ant Attack on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Ant Attack is a Commodore 64 arcade game released in 1984 by Quicksilva. Set in a city overrun by giant ants, you must rescue survivors while avoiding relentless enemies. Its isometric viewpoint and sense of tension made it a highly influential title and a standout early horror-themed game on the C64.

Antheads: It Came From The Desert II is an Amiga adventure game released in 1990 by Cinemaware. Serving as a sequel to the original, it expands on the pulp sci-fi storyline with new locations, characters, and gameplay mechanics. The game continues Cinemaware's trademark cinematic approach to interactive storytelling.

video:video.video:title: Apocalypse – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Apocalypse on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Apocalypse is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up released for the Amiga in 1994 by Virgin Interactive. you battle waves of enemies across futuristic environments, relying on fast reflexes and heavy firepower. The game is noted for its smooth scrolling, detailed visuals, and late-era Amiga polish.

video:video.video:title: Apollo 18: Mission To The Moon – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer

Apollo 18: Mission To The Moon is a Commodore 64 strategy and simulation game released by Accolade in 1987. you manage a space mission inspired by the Apollo programme, balancing planning, resource management, and decision-making. The game is praised for its educational angle and thoughtful approach to space exploration.

video:video.video:title: Arachnophobia – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Arachnophobia on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Arachnophobia is a Commodore 64 arcade game released in 1991 by Titus, based on the horror film of the same name. you must eliminate giant spiders while protecting civilians and navigating maze-like environments. The game blends action with tension, making it a memorable licensed horror title on the C64.

video:video.video:title: Arcade Classics – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer

Arcade Classics is a Commodore 64 compilation released by Firebird in 1987. The collection brings together a selection of fast-paced arcade-style games, each focusing on reflex-based gameplay and score chasing. It reflects Firebird's budget-label approach, offering accessible arcade action in a single package for C64 owners.

video:video.video:title: Arcade Flight Simulator – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Arcade Flight Simulator on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Arcade Flight Simulator is a Commodore 64 action game released by Codemasters in 1989. Designed to be more accessible than traditional flight simulators, it combines simple controls with fast-paced aerial combat. The game focuses on arcade-style dogfighting rather than realism, making it easy to pick up and play.

video:video.video:title: Arcade Pool – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Arcade Pool on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Arcade Pool is an Amiga sports and strategy game released by Team17 in 1994. Featuring a realistic pool simulation with an intuitive interface, the game allows you to compete across a variety of rule sets and table layouts. It is widely regarded as one of the finest cue sports games on the Amiga.

video:video.video:title: Archon: The Light And The Dark – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Archon: The Light And The Dark on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Archon: The Light and the Dark is a Commodore 64 strategy game released in 1983 by Ariolasoft. Combining board-game strategy with real-time arcade combat, you command opposing fantasy forces battling for control of a shifting chessboard-like arena. The game is celebrated as a pioneering hybrid that influenced strategy design for years to come.

video:video.video:title: Arctic Shipwreck – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Arctic Shipwreck on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Arctic Shipwreck is a Commodore 64 arcade game released by Commodore in 1983. you must navigate icy waters and hazardous conditions while rescuing survivors from a stranded vessel. As an early C64 title, it showcases simple mechanics paired with steadily increasing difficulty.

video:video.video:title: Arkanoid – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Arkanoid on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Arkanoid is a Commodore 64 conversion of Taito's hugely successful arcade block-breaking game, released in 1987. you control a paddle to deflect a ball, clearing screens of bricks while collecting power-ups that alter gameplay. The C64 version remains a favourite thanks to its addictive mechanics and faithful arcade feel.

video:video.video:title: Army Moves – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Army Moves on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Army Moves is a Commodore 64 action game released in 1987 by Imagine. you guide a soldier through hostile territory across multiple stages, combining side-scrolling action with shooting sequences. The game is known for its high difficulty and striking visual style.

video:video.video:title: Arnie – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Arnie on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Arnie is a Commodore 64 arcade shooter released by Zeppelin Games in 1992. Clearly inspired by action film heroes of the era, the game features fast-paced shooting and enemy-filled stages. It represents one of the later arcade-style releases for the C64, arriving late in the system's commercial life.

video:video.video:title: Asterix And The Magic Cauldron – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Asterix And The Magic Cauldron on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Asterix and the Magic Cauldron is a Commodore 64 action-adventure game released in 1986 by Melbourne House. Based on the famous comic series, you control Asterix as he journeys through Gaul collecting ingredients while avoiding enemies. The game is remembered for its colourful presentation and faithful use of the Asterix licence.

video:video.video:title: Attack Of The Mutant Camels – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Attack Of The Mutant Camels on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Attack of the Mutant Camels is a Commodore 64 arcade shooter created by Llamasoft in 1983. you defend their base from waves of bizarre, laser-firing camels in a fast and chaotic battle. The game is an early example of Jeff Minter's distinctive style, blending surreal themes with intense arcade action.

video:video.video:title: Auf Wiedersehen Monty – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Auf Wiedersehen Monty on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Auf Wiedersehen Monty is a Commodore 64 platform game released by Gremlin Graphics in 1987. Continuing Monty Mole's adventures, the game challenges you to explore large levels, collect items, and manage resources carefully. It is often praised for its depth, humour, and strong European flavour.

video:video.video:title: Aussie Games – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Aussie Games on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Aussie Games is a Commodore 64 sports compilation released by Mindscape in 1989. Inspired by Australian sporting events, the game features a variety of skill-based challenges that test timing and precision. It offers light-hearted competitive play in a distinctly regional setting.

video:video.video:title: Automania – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Automania on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Automania is a Commodore 64 platform game released by Mikro-Gen in 1984. you take on the role of a mechanic racing against time to assemble cars while navigating hazardous factory environments. Known for its quirky presentation and demanding gameplay, it later inspired the similarly themed Manic Mechanic.

video:video.video:title: Aztec Challenge – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Aztec Challenge on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Aztec Challenge is a Commodore 64 arcade game released by Cosmi in 1983. you attempt to survive a series of deadly trials inspired by ancient Aztec rituals, relying on precise timing and quick reactions. Its brutal difficulty made it one of the more notorious early C64 titles.

video:video.video:title: Back To Reality – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Back To Reality on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Back to Reality is a Commodore 64 arcade action game released by Mastertronic in 1986. you navigate surreal environments filled with hazards and enemies, relying on quick reflexes to survive. Like many Mastertronic titles, it delivers straightforward action at a budget price point.

video:video.video:title: Back To The Future – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Back To The Future on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Back to the Future is a Commodore 64 action-adventure game released in 1986 by Electric Dreams, based on the hit film. you guide Marty McFly through a variety of gameplay sections inspired by key scenes from the movie. The game is notable for its ambition in translating a major film licence to the C64.

video:video.video:title: Bad Dudes Vs Dragonninja – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Bad Dudes Vs Dragonninja on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Bad Dudes vs Dragon Ninja is a Commodore 64 beat 'em up released in 1989 by Imagine. A conversion of the Data East arcade hit, the game tasks you with fighting through waves of enemies using punches, kicks, and special moves. It captures the arcade brawler formula that defined late-1980s action games.

video:video.video:title: Badlands – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Badlands on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Badlands is a Commodore 64 racing and arcade action game released by Domark in 1990. Set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, you race armed vehicles across hazardous tracks while battling rival drivers. The game blends high-speed racing with vehicular combat for intense arcade-style gameplay.

video:video.video:title: Bangkok Knights – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Bangkok Knights on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Bangkok Knights is a Commodore 64 fighting game released in 1987 by System 3. Combining martial arts combat with light adventure elements, you progress through levels by defeating enemies and collecting items. The game is remembered for its large character sprites and distinctive setting.

video:video.video:title: Barbarian II: The Dungeon Of Drax – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Barbarian II: The Dungeon Of Drax on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. video:video.video:title: Barbarian: The Ultimate Warrior – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Barbarian: The Ultimate Warrior on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Barbarian: The Ultimate Warrior is a Commodore 64 fighting game released in 1987 by Palace Software. video:video.video:title: Barry Mcguigan World Championship Boxing – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Barry Mcguigan World Championship Boxing on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Barry McGuigan World Championship Boxing is a Commodore 64 sports game released by Activision in 1985. video:video.video:title: Batman: The Caped Crusader – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Batman: The Caped Crusader on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Batman: The Caped Crusader is a Commodore 64 action-adventure game released in 1988 by Data East. you take on the role of Batman across multiple missions, each featuring different gameplay styles and villains from the comic universe. The game is praised for its ambition and varied structure.

video:video.video:title: Batman: The Movie – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Batman: The Movie on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Batman: The Movie is a Commodore 64 action-adventure game released by Ocean in 1986. Inspired by the iconic film character rather than a specific movie plot, the game mixes side-scrolling action with puzzle elements. It became one of Ocean's most recognisable licensed releases.

video:video.video:title: Battle Chess – Amiga Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Battle Chess on Amiga with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. video:video.video:title: B.C. Bill – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer

video:video.video:title: B.C. II: Grog's Revenge – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer

video:video.video:title: B.C.'S Quest For Tires – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer

B.C.'s Quest for Tires is a Commodore 64 arcade platform game released in 1984 by Software Projects. you control Thor, a caveman searching for missing stone wheels across dangerous landscapes. video:video.video:title: Beach-Head – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Beach-Head on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary. Beach-Head is a Commodore 64 arcade and strategy hybrid released in 1983 by Access Software. you attempt to invade and capture an enemy island through a series of action sequences, including artillery defense and ground assaults. It is regarded as one of the most influential early C64 titles.

video:video.video:title: Beach-Head II – C64 Gameplay & Review | Cheeky Commodore Gamer
video:video.video:description: Watch Beach-Head II on Commodore 64 with Cheeky Commodore Gamer video coverage, gameplay and commentary.
